decision.observation: 10:50 pm, rain. Camera panned; the cobblestone road/terrace runs east-west across the middle of the view, with grass below and bushes to the west. The farmer is hidden behind the raised road edge.
decision.hypothesis: The farmer is just south of the cobblestone road; heading west along the grass below it should reach the road that leads out of town toward the bus stop and farm.
decision.memory: Home route: town → west road → bus stop → farm north gap → south to farmhouse. Introductions 7/28; 450g; half energy; Wed 3, 10:50 pm rain.
